scout_postings.title: Ohio jobs requiring R and Tableau

querychat_viz_widgets.ggsql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    location_city,
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS posting_count
  FROM scout_postings
  WHERE LOWER(location_state) IN ('ohio', 'oh')
    AND LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(title, '')) LIKE '%r%'
    AND LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(title, '')) LIKE '%tableau%'
  GROUP BY location_city, category
)
SELECT location_city, category, posting_count
FROM filtered
VISUALISE location_city AS y, posting_count AS x, category AS fill
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Number of postings', y => 'Ohio city'
